say:2:1610337001:1.text: Welcome, how may I help you?
say:2:1610337001:1.source_cn: 你们好，请问需要什么魔法材料？

say:3:1610337002:1.source_cn: 我们想买<style=highlight>金色棱光石晶...

say:4:1610337003:1.text: This kind of crystal is very rare, so the price will be a little more expensive than the others...
say:4:1610337003:1.source_cn: 这种晶体很稀有，所以价钱会比较贵一点……

say:5:1610337004:1.text: I see. How much are they?
say:5:1610337004:1.source_cn: 嗯，我知道了，一共要多少钱？

say:6:1610337005:1.text: You stop Cassadee from paying, haggle with sharp skill, and strike a great deal for a stash of goldprism crystals.
say:6:1610337005:1.source_cn: 你拦住了科丝蒂付款的行为，以挑剔而熟练的口吻砍价，最终...
say:6:1610337005:1.male: You stop Cassadee from paying, haggle with sharp skill, and strike a great deal for a stash of goldprism crystals.
say:6:1610337005:1.female: You stop Cassadee from paying, haggle with sharp skill, and strike a great deal for a stash of goldprism crystals.
